title: Just the Recipe
meta_description: Skip the clutter on recipe websites and get straight to the instructions.
full_description: Just the Recipe eliminates the clutter from any recipe website and displays . Convert messy recipe blogs into simple, beautiful recipe cards.Cook recipes without losing your spot because of all the unnecessary text, photos, ads, and popups. No more scrolling through someone's life story when you're trying to cook.Here's what JustTheRecipe will do for you:✨ Save yourself the frustration of scrolling through huge websites filled with unnecessary content. Share any recipe site from your web browser to our app to get just the instructions.📖 Keep your favorite recipes in a digital recipe book to find them again later. Store up to 20 for free, or unlock unlimited slots by upgrading to Premium membership.✍️ Use the recipe editor to make any adjustments to the recipes you save. Modify the ingredients, instructions, title, and more. You can even add your own notes or a custom image!📄 Keep all your favorite recipes in one place by adding your own recipes to your cookbook -- even the ones that you didn't get from a website!💻 Automatically share your saved recipes between your devices when you choose to create a free account. Access the recipe keeper from any device using the JustTheRecipe app or on our website, JustTheRecipe.com.🌙 Enjoy the sleek and simple user interface in either light or dark mode. Optionally sync the app's theme with your device's brightness setting.👑 With a Premium membership, you'll unlock the full power of the app.· Save an  number of recipes to your cookbook· Adjust the number of servings to scale a recipe up or down· Print any recipe or save it to a PDF· Get lightning-fast responses with priority support
